Initial release of create-agent-harness: a tool to bootstrap or migrate a production-ready agent harness for modern AI agent workflows.

- Bootstraps CLAUDE.md and .claude/ with all required artifacts, memory protocol, and deterministic controls for agent orchestration.
- Migrates legacy harness structures (AGENTS.md, .agents/, .devin/, .cursorrules, .windsurf) into .claude/, removing the originals; ensures no parallel legacy remains.
- Generates thin, platform-specific references for Devin CLI/Desktop, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini, Antigravity, and OpenClaw, all pointing to the single source of truth in CLAUDE.md and .claude/.
- Enforces strict execution rules: no work on main/master/develop branches, cites seen repository evidence for every generated statement, and prioritizes computational controls over prompts.
- Runs in 5 sequential phases, opening with immediate discovery—never asking what to do—and pausing only for human confirmation before changes.
